name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main, "codex/vickie-*"]

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          # The evidence gate proves run-head ancestry and delta confinement
          # with git history; a shallow clone cannot decide either fact.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4
        with:
          version: 11.20.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24.16.0
          cache: pnpm
      - uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6
        with:
          go-version: 1.26.2
          cache: false
      - run: test "$(node --version)" = "v24.16.0"
      - run: test "$(pnpm --version)" = "11.20.0"
      - run: sudo apt-get update
      - run: sudo apt-get install --yes libicu-dev
      - run: mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/bdp-tools"
      - run: go install github.com/steveyegge/beads/cmd/bd@v1.0.5
        env:
          GOBIN: ${{ runner.temp }}/bdp-tools
      - name: Verify the Go-installed source-build bd identity
        run: |
          test "$(cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/bdp-tools" && ./bd --version)" = "bd version 1.0.5 (dev)"
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/bdp-tools" && ./bd version --json) | node -e '
            const { isDeepStrictEqual } = require("node:util");
            let source = "";
            process.stdin.setEncoding("utf8");
            process.stdin.on("data", (chunk) => { source += chunk; });
            process.stdin.on("end", () => {
              const actual = JSON.parse(source);
              const expected = { build: "dev", schema_version: 1, version: "1.0.5" };
              if (!isDeepStrictEqual(actual, expected)) process.exit(1);
            });
          '
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm format:check
      - run: pnpm lint
      - run: pnpm check:boundaries
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      # Real Node child-process tests resolve workspace package exports from dist.
      - run: pnpm build
      - run: pnpm test
        env:
          BDP_BD_MATRIX_EXECUTABLE: ${{ runner.temp }}/bdp-tools/bd
          BDP_REQUIRE_BD_MATRIX: "1"
      - run: pnpm e2e:ready:preflight
      - run: pnpm smoke
      - name: Read-cohort evidence gate
        # Exit 2 alone passes: it means no evidence is claimed and shipping
        # admission stays fail-closed. Exit 1 (claimed but unproved) and exit 3
        # (the gate could not inspect the claim — missing or stale build) both
        # fail the job; a claim that cannot be checked is not a passing state.
        run: pnpm evidence:verify || test $? -eq 2
